lines: You already know which one you are.
caption:
King, Explorer or Jester. Pick one before you overthink it.

The King wants order. The Explorer wants freedom. The Jester wants everyone to have a good time. Most of us recognise a bit of all three, but one usually wins.

Which one did you pick?

Comment ARCHETYPE and I'll send you the test 📩

#archetypes #selfawareness #personality
